## Key Enterprise Projects (Under NDA / Enterprise Intranet)
1. Skills-Training Exam Platform (بخش آزمون پلتفرم مهارت‌آموزی فنی و حرفه‌ای)
   - Role: Technical Project Manager & Scrum Lead
   - Challenge: Managing sudden severe traffic surges with tens of thousands of simultaneous test-takers while guaranteeing zero data loss or race conditions in answer submissions.
   - Solution & Architecture: Engineered a distributed architecture using C# .NET Core and Angular with layered in-memory caching and asynchronous queue processing.
   - Key Metrics & Impact: Successfully sustained 50,000+ concurrent examinees with 99.98% uptime and zero submission loss nationwide.
   - Technologies: Angular, C# .NET Core, SQL Server, Clean Architecture, Scrum, High Concurrency.

2. Moghan Agro-Industry Comprehensive Financial System (سامانه مالی کشت و صنعت و دامپروری مغان)
   - Role: Technical Project Manager & Software Architect
   - Challenge: Consolidating financial and cost-accounting workflows across multiple massive agro-industrial divisions with audit-proof tracking.
   - Solution & Architecture: Implemented Domain-Centric Clean Architecture in .NET Core, highly indexed SQL Server schemas, and Stimulsoft reporting pipelines.
   - Key Metrics & Impact: Reduced month-end reporting time by 40% and reliably processed 100,000+ annual financial transactions.
   - Technologies: .NET Core, Angular, SQL Server, Stimulsoft Reports, Financial Modules.

3. Warehouse Management System — Oil Products Distribution Co. (سامانه انبارداری شرکت فرآورده‌های نفتی)
   - Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer
   - Challenge: Zero tolerance for inventory discrepancies in bulk fuel depots with sub-second response times on massive transactional ledgers.
   - Solution & Architecture: Implemented high-throughput C# .NET Core Web APIs, fine-tuned SQL Server execution plans, and parameterized reporting pipelines.
   - Key Metrics & Impact: Sub-300ms query retrieval on complex stock queries and 100% audit-reconciled stock movements.
   - Technologies: C#, .NET Core, SQL Server, RESTful API, Stimulsoft Reports, Inventory Ledger.

4. Employment Administration System (سامانه اداره استخدامی)
   - Role: Senior Full-Stack Developer
   - Challenge: Maintaining strict confidentiality of applicant records, complex evaluation rubrics, and a snappy applicant management UX.
   - Solution & Architecture: Developed dynamic Angular and TypeScript components with strict RBAC authorization and hardened .NET backend services.
   - Key Metrics & Impact: Accelerated applicant evaluation turnaround by 50% across departmental recruitment committees.
   - Technologies: Angular, TypeScript, C# .NET, SQL Server, RBAC Security.

5. "Training 500 Young & Efficient Managers" Examination System (آزمون طرح تربیت ۵۰۰ مدیر جوان و کارآمد)
   - Role: Project Manager & Operations Lead
   - Challenge: High-stakes executive selection requiring fail-safe session persistence, uninterrupted connectivity resilience, and instant grading.
   - Solution & Architecture: Led technical sprints, pre-flight load stress simulations, client-side auto-save synchronization, and live session monitoring.
   - Key Metrics & Impact: Flawless test delivery with 100% zero-downtime delivery and instant automated psychometric and technical score generation upon test completion.
   - Technologies: Project Management, Angular, .NET Core, SQL Server, High Concurrency, Scrum.
